## Bathcat intake-gap report

- Stable intake slug: `dominion`
- BGG ID: `36218`
- Cohort attempted: `rotating_focus`
- Focus fit: Dominion is a classic market-centric competitive deckbuilder, matching the wishlist's deck-building pattern gap.
- Scope: released physical base game; exact printing not frozen because governing rules evidence was not retrievable.

### Shortfall
The candidate did not meet `ready_for_audit`. The official core rulebook was not retrieved from an official endpoint, so the bounded governing-document inventory cannot be closed. No packet or canonical tree was created. Independent reception and meaningful visual receipts were not completed after the primary-rules gate failed.

### Attempted sources and outcomes
- Wishlist lead: `WISHLIST.md`, classic market-centric competitive deckbuilder.
- Identity lead: https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/36218/dominion — discovery only; not used as official rules evidence.
- Official publisher page: https://riograndegames.com/games/dominion/ — direct retrieval returned HTTP 403 (`text/html`, 5,491 bytes); no official rulebook file was acquired.
- Candidate publisher PDF paths tested: `https://riograndegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Dominion-Rulebook.pdf` and `https://riograndegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Dominion-Rules.pdf` — both HTTP 404.

### Help requested
Provide an official or authorized exact-edition core rulebook URL and confirm the printing. After that, retrieve an independent review outside Rio Grande Games and BGG plus at least two meaningful source-linked visuals from permitted sources.

This is a research gap, not an infrastructure failure.
